analyst_error_history.cause: The responder withheld commands for every msg key. The main loop sends cleared msg:[] after CMD, which was incorrectly treated like the worker msg:string response whose next_data is ignored. This stalled analyst task delivery after CMD.
analyst_error_history.correction: Withhold only msg string values; cleared-list main-loop polls can receive the next command after acknowledgment and the full pacing gap.

regression.checks: Full nine-step sequence; string workers withheld; cleared-list advancement; no acknowledgment for wrong markers/lists; pre-gap withholding; exact-gap dispatch; duplicates do not reset pacing.

analyst_error_history.partial_procmon_review: Partial PML exceeded the original 1 GiB reviewer bound and was preserved without parsing. PML/source bounds were later raised to 4 GiB; compressed transfer stays 1 GiB. This is an analyst tooling bound, not specimen behavior.
analyst_error_history.use_limit: Attempt1 remains a preserved partial experiment; the command table uses only the corrected final run.

analyst_error_history.cause: Procmon backing-file readiness missed the original25-second deadline. The MSI was not launched. A later128MiB PML was force-closed and its capture integrity is unverified.
analyst_error_history.correction: Extended bounded wait and persisted setup progress checkpoints plus safe failure line numbers; isolation, specimen hashes and fixed actions unchanged.
analyst_error_history.stale_host_copy_note: An earlier host copy still showed preparing; the later final summary did save. This was not evidence of a current hang or failed final reporting.

analyst_error_history.cause: At script scope, foreach($owned...) overwrote the case-insensitive $script:Owned process collection with the installer-client object. The later payload cleanup loop never visited PID8912.
analyst_error_history.synthetic_reproduction: An inert three-object collection becomes the installer-client object after the script-scope loop; the later payload filter sees zero entries. No guest action was needed to reproduce the language-scope defect.
analyst_error_history.effect: Pinned payload was omitted from historical cleanup and remained alive; Kali polling continued beyond the Windows observation/PML window.
analyst_error_history.remediation: Separate fixed guest helper revalidated exact creation time, path, size and hash, retained a kernel handle, stopped only that payload identity and confirmed exit.
